root.description: The project's canonical root at removal time.

registryRemoved.description: The durable global-registry entry (and its indexes) were removed.

journalPartitionArchived.description: Whether the project's journal partition directory was archived (renamed out of the active journal tree). False only when the partition never materialized on disk.

archivedPartitionPath.description: Absolute path the partition journal was archived to, or null when there was no partition directory to archive.

artifactsRetained.description: Run artifact trees are left in place for normal GC/retention — remove never deletes run bytes or the user's project directory.

activeRunCheck.description: How the live/queued-run fence was evaluated. Always 'snapshot': the daemon reads its in-process activity projection and removes the project in the same synchronous turn, with no await between the snapshot and registry/partition mutation.

threadId.description: The thread that was in the project's trash and is now purged.

cleanup.description: completed: every directory the thread purge owns is deleted. pending: the purge is committed but that deletion did not finish; the engine retries it when the daemon next starts.

cleanupError.description: Why the deletion did not finish; null when cleanup completed.

items.description: A trashed thread purged together with its project.

purgedThreads.description: Present only when the request opted in with trashedThreads=purge: every thread that was in the project's trash, purged in the same store transaction that retired the project. Absent on a default removal.

ControlProjectRemoveReceipt.description: DELETE /v2/projects/:id receipt: registry entry removed, journal partition archived, artifacts left to GC.
